structured.answer: I'd go with option 1, "החברה בראש השורה". I tap the S&P 500 group and get one list with each company's name in bold and its fee right next to it. Cheapest is at the top: מנורה מבטחים at 0.52%, then הראל at 0.56%, which I know from ads. Option 3 has the "מומלץ" badge, but it opens with a big grid of near-identical brown percentages, and I'd close it.

stuck.where: Top tabs 1/2/3 and the inner tabs (מקור, מדריכים, לפי מוצר/לפי חברה)
stuck.why: There are two rows of tabs and a few headings that all say 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות', so at first I didn't know which part was the option and which was the page itself

stuck.where: Option 2, the screens grouped by company (הראל, מור)
stuck.why: Each company has 15–16 tracks with names I don't know (אג"ח סחיר, אשראי ואג"ח, כספי שקלי). To find the S&P one for each company I'd have to scroll through all of them, so I gave up comparing there
It's 12 rows by 12 columns of 0.5x–0.7% in brown shades. I didn't read the line above it, so I guessed darker brown meant expensive. I couldn't see a winner
There are two fees per row. I only looked at the top one; the 0%/0.01% one I ignored

findings.what: Option 3, the one marked recommended, opens with a dense grid of almost identical percentages. Nothing next to the shading tells you what the colours mean, so on a phone it's a wall of numbers
findings.where: Screen 08–09, 'כל החברות מול כל סוגי ההשקעה'

findings.what: Fees only appear as tiny percents (0.52% vs 0.71%), which feel the same; nothing shows what that difference is in shekels
Option 2 buries the S&P track inside 15–16 tracks per company, so you can't compare companies without scrolling forever
Two fee lines per row, with the second almost always 0%, which is confusing
Big return numbers (13.79%) catch the eye, but many companies show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead, so it looks like they're missing data
Repeated identical headings 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות' and tab rows make it hard to tell where one option ends and the next begins
Unfamiliar companies (אנליסט, אינפיניטי, איילון, ילין לפידות) sit among the big names with no hint who they are
